title: Orange Zest Smoky Croatian Lamb Bowl
description: A smoky and crunchy Croatian dish featuring orange zest, perfect for a date night, served in an earthenware bowl and suitable for a shojin-friendly diet.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together orange zest, smoked paprika, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the mixture all over the lamb shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, then transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the lamb for 2 hours, or until it is tender and falls apart easily.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the dates by slicing them into thin wedges.
Once the lamb is done, let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing it into thin strips.
To assemble the bowls, place a portion of the lamb into an earthenware bowl, then top with dates, parsley, and a drizzle of olive oil.
